assumptions: Success rate means attempt-level success rate: successful attempts divided by all attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt. Order-level and technical rates are shown alongside.
Period analysed: 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, compared with 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-30.
caveats: Duplicate records on 12 Oct: 341 attempts were ingested twice (11,704 raw rows vs 11,363 unique attempts, +3.0%). Paysight counts each attempt once, keeping the first ingestion.

Volume spike 18 Oct–31 Oct: attempt volume was +39% versus the usual level for those weekdays over 14 days. Sales and data gaps both look like this, so check before comparing totals across this period.
Failure codes are reported per 100 attempts, not as shares of failures.
The daily rows shown in the evidence cover only the early part of the comparison period, so a day-by-day view of October itself is not available here.

facts.text: Across 1–31 October 2026 the attempt success rate was 89.2% (384,193 successes out of 430,580 attempts).

In the comparison period (31 Aug–30 Sep) the rate was 89.7% (326,607 successes out of 364,324 attempts). The October rate fell 0.42pp, and the confidence ranges (89.55%–89.75% before, 89.13%–89.32% in October) do not overlap.
The change is statistically significant (p-value 1.25e-09) but is not flagged as practically significant.
Attempt volume in October was 430,580 versus 364,324 in the comparison period.

NovaMart is the segment that concentrates the change most: its success rate fell from 89.5% to 86.8%. Other dimensions ranked lower: issuer, category (electronics 89.1% to 87.7%), acquirer, region and channel.

Within NovaMart, the hours with a statistically significant drop were 0, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 22 and 23. For example, hour 0 fell 6.10pp (93.0% to 86.9%) and hour 9 fell 5.67pp (92.1% to 86.4%).

For NovaMart, per 100 attempts, AUTH_3DS_ABANDONED rose from 0.49 to 1.72, EMI_NOT_ELIGIBLE from 0.17 to 1.18, DO_NOT_HONOR from 0.64 to 1.55, ISSUER_RISK_DECLINE from 0.12 to 0.80 and INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS from 0.77 to 1.40.
For NovaMart, per 100 attempts, UPI_COLLECT_EXPIRED fell from 1.32 to 0.58 and NB_SESSION_ABANDONED fell from 0.85 to 0.37.

response.headline: October's attempt success rate was 89.2%, down 0.42pp from 89.7% in the prior period (31 Aug–30 Sep). The dip is statistically real but small, and it is concentrated in the NovaMart merchant group.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Compare NovaMart's payment-method mix and per-method success rates between the two periods, and check the sale calendar against 18–31 Oct.
hypotheses.rationale: NovaMart is the top segment in the scan, volume rose in the second half of October, and the failure-code shift is toward EMI and card-related codes while UPI and net-banking drop-off codes fell.
hypotheses.text: A NovaMart sale or campaign in October shifted its payment mix toward EMI and card payments, which fail more often (3-D Secure abandonment, EMI ineligibility, issuer declines), pulling the overall rate down.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Run the payment-method mix/rate decomposition for NovaMart and break issuer declines down by issuer and card type.
hypotheses.rationale: Issuer-decline and risk-decline codes rose per 100 attempts, but the evidence does not separate mix from like-for-like rate change.
hypotheses.text: Part of the NovaMart decline is genuine issuer-side or risk-rule tightening (higher DO_NOT_HONOR and ISSUER_RISK_DECLINE) rather than only a mix effect.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: A NovaMart sale or campaign in October shifted its payment mix toward EMI and card payments
recommendations.rationale: AUTH_3DS_ABANDONED and EMI_NOT_ELIGIBLE showed the largest increases per 100 attempts for NovaMart.
recommendations.text: Investigate NovaMart's checkout flow for card and EMI payments, particularly 3-D Secure completion and EMI eligibility messaging.

recommendations.rationale: DO_NOT_HONOR and ISSUER_RISK_DECLINE rose per 100 attempts.
recommendations.text: Review risk-rule and issuer-decline behaviour for NovaMart with acquirers and issuers.

recommendations.text: Confirm NovaMart's October campaign dates and payment mix before judging whether this is a real performance decline.
